name: fmp_earnings_calendar
description:
Earnings announcement calendar from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/earning-calendar): report dates, EPS estimate vs actual, revenue estimate vs actual.
Returns {events}: FMP's list of earnings events.
Inputs (* required): from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD), symbol (ticker filter); all optional, FMP's default window applies without dates.
For dividends, IPOs, splits and macro releases use fmp_dividend_calendar, fmp_ipo_calendar, fmp_stock_split_calendar, fmp_economic_calendar; for call text fmp_earnings_transcript.
Example: {"from_date": "2025-07-01", "to_date": "2025-07-31"}
